name: an equal slice attempt from a second agent id never collides

source.assertion:
assert_equals "simultaneous equal slice attempts with different agent ids never collide" \
  "publish=a=0:: b=0:: a=rc=0:$(expected_receipt parent-a slice-shared 1 agent-shared-a oso-verifier) b=rc=0:$(expected_receipt parent-b slice-shared 1 agent-shared-b oso-verifier)" \
  "publish=$shared_publish_status a=$shared_a_consumed b=$shared_b_consumed"

state_before..local/state/oso-code/.handoffs/{repo}/{:
version=1
hook_session=parent-a
slice=slice-shared
attempt=1
agent_id=agent-shared-a
agent_type=oso-verifier

stdin:
oso-handoff: v=1 slice=slice-shared attempt=1
verdict: blocked

state_after..local/state/oso-code/.handoffs/{repo}/{:
version=1
hook_session=parent-a
slice=slice-shared
attempt=1
agent_id=agent-shared-a
agent_type=oso-verifier

version=1
hook_session=parent-b
slice=slice-shared
attempt=1
agent_id=agent-shared-b
agent_type=oso-verifier
